system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 18. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (20 seconds, code score 0.89) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.
[b01] JULIANA (frantic, desperate): "The ledger!"
[b02] ACTION: Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.
[b03] ALEXANDER (stern, shouting): "Leave it!"
[b04] JULIANA (hysterical, screaming): "No! No!"
[b05] ACTION: Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.
[b06] ALEXANDER (loud, alarmed): "Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!"
[b07] ACTION: Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.
[b08] ALEXANDER (roaring in terror): "Juliana!"
[b09] JULIANA (defiant, weeping): "It's my mother's!"

--- WINDOW 1 (56 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.
[b01] JULIANA (screaming, terrified): "Alexander!"
[b02] JULIANA (desperate, shouting): "Alexander!"
[b03] ACTION: Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.
[b04] JULIANA (muffled, weeping): "Alexander..."
[b05] SFX: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
[b06] ALEXANDER (authoritative, urgency): "Juliana! Get up!"
[b07] ACTION: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.
[b08] JULIANA (breathless, distressed): "What happened?"
[b09] ALEXANDER (grim, urgent): "Fire."
[b10] ACTION: Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.
[b11] ALEXANDER (firm, protective): "Stay close to me."
[b12] ACTION: Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.
[b13] JULIANA (panic-stricken, choked): "We cannot get through!"
[b14] ALEXANDER (resolute, calm under pressure): "Then we go another way."
[b15] SFX: Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
[b16] ACTION: Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.
[b17] JULIANA (frantic, desperate): "The ledger!"
[b18] ACTION: Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.
[b19] ALEXANDER (stern, shouting): "Leave it!"
[b20] JULIANA (hysterical, screaming): "No! No!"

--- WINDOW 2 (33 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (roaring in terror): "Juliana!"
[b01] JULIANA (defiant, weeping): "It's my mother's!"
[b02] ACTION: Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.
[b03] JULIANA (screaming, blood-curdling): "Alexander!"
[b04] ALEXANDER (screaming command): "Down!"
[b05] ACTION: Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.
[b06] SFX: Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.
[b07] ACTION: Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.
[b08] ALEXANDER (panting, reassuring): "I've got you."
[b09] ACTION: Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.
[b10] ACTION: Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.
[b11] JULIANA (urgent, shouting): "The window!"
[b12] ALEXANDER (steely, determined): "Hold on to me."

--- WINDOW 3 (22 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.
[b01] JULIANA (voice breaking, anguished): "Why would anyone do this?"
[b02] JULIANA (whispering, tearful): "Alexander..."
[b03] ACTION: Alexander draws her firmly into his arms, wrapping both burly arms around her as she buries her face into his shoulder, weeping uncontrollably.
[b04] ALEXANDER (cold, ominous): "Someone wanted us out."
[b05] JULIANA (despairing, weeping): "We have nowhere to go."

Pick the single best promo.
